title: SSC MTS 2023 Tier-1 Art & Culture PART-3

questions.question: ___________ word of Indian dance is derived from a Sanskrit word and literally means ‘taking towards’.
Which form of Indian dance is said to be ‘soft and suitable for female presentation’?
Rukmini Devi Arundale was associated with which Indian classical dance from?
_____________ was a star of the Kathak dance form described as ‘Nritya Samragini’ (the empress of dance) by Rabindranath Tagore.
The Rathwas, who dwell in the state of ___________, perform the Rathwa dance on the occasion of Holi (festival of colours).
In the ________ dance performance, the Raas dance is performed by women on one side, while on the opposite side the players play pung cholom (drum) and kartal (cymbals).
The word 'Kathak' has originated from which of the following words?
The classical dance style of Bharatanatyam belongs to the state of ____________.
The Lambadi dance is a folk dance form of the ____________ tribe and originated in Andhra Pradesh.
Who is the first female classical dancer in Indian history to be nominated as a Member of Rajya Sabha, the upper house of the Parliament of India?
Who among the following is credited with starting a Fusion Dance form called ‘Hi-Dance’?
The technique of classical dancing was codified by ______________ in about the 5th century B.C.
Which of the following is a famous folk dance of Rajasthan?
The ____________ maestros who revived the art form in the late 1940s include Kelucharan Mohapatra and Raghunath Dutta.

Match the following performances of Indian naatya, which were presented by the means of variegated components:
1) Angika [a] costumes and make-up
2) Vachika [b] depiction of mental or psychological states
3) Aharya [c] spoken words
4) Sattivika [d] gestures and other bodily movements
The Balti dance of ____________ is distinct as it has its own costume, music and songs in the Balti language. The dance is only performed on rare occasions, such as feasts or celebrations.
The Sakraat festival is celebrated with the ‘Budigali’ or ‘Kalasi’ dance in ___________, where women take part in this dance, carrying decorative pots on their heads.
The Padma shri awardee (2016) Gulabo Sapera is known as the Queen of _________ dance.
Chhau is a major dance tradition of India. In which of the following Indian states is the dance form NOT prevalent?
Who among the following is the Indian classical dancer who masters both Bharatanatyam and Odissi dancing style?
Deba Prasad Das, Pankaj Charan Das and Gangadhar Pradhan are associated with which of the following dance forms?
Mohiniyattam is a classical dance style belongs to ________________.
Rohini Bhate, Pandit Munnalal Shukla, Kumudini Lakhia and Uma Sharma are famous exponents of which of the following classical dance forms?

The fundamental vocabulary of __________ dance constitutes mock combat techniques, stylised gaits of birds and animals and movements modelled on the chores of village housewives and mostly performed by male dancers in Eastern India.
To which of the state does Sattriya classical dance belong?
